environment.description: Go Gin application deployed as a Kubernetes pod in namespace 'backend-services'. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP Service on port 8080. No Istio sidecar injection is configured for this namespace. Other pods in the cluster (including attacker workloads in namespace 'data-pipeline') can directly reach the service endpoint via cluster DNS (token-validator.backend-services.svc.cluster.local:8080).
